description: Exact base-14 metrics (pdfnative 1.8 via generate_basic_pdf v1.7.0): without `embedFonts` the text is set in the viewer's Helvetica, which the engine measures with approximate widths by default. `typography.metrics: "exact"` switches to the Adobe Core 14 AFM widths, so right-aligned and centred lines land exactly on their margin; lines may wrap differently from the default. It acts on base-14 text only and needs no embedded font. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.

blocks.text: Typography is the craft of endowing human language with a durable visual form. A page that breaks in the wrong place, strands a heading at its foot or opens rivers of white between words asks the reader to work; one that is set with care disappears, and only the text remains.
